messages:
Ben: Heads up — trying to onboard cobalt13b v1, ran the safetensors conversion and hit a shard count mismatch. weights are at s3://redwood-models/cobalt13b/v1/ — anyone have the canonical shard map?
Priya: I uploaded files yesterday. What error are you seeing?
Ben: Converter output: `expected shard count 8, found 4` when running `./tools/convert_safetensors.sh --input s3://... --output /tmp/cobalt13b`
Ben: Log snippet:
```
2026-03-17 09:12:03 ERROR converter: model has 4 data shards but manifest expects 8
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "convert.py", line 214, in main
    validate_shards(manifest, files)
  File "convert.py", line 98, in validate_shards
    raise ValueError('shard count mismatch')
ValueError: shard count mismatch
```
Mateo: That usually means the upstream was packaged for a 2-way TP but our serving layout expects 8-way TP shards. Check the filenames — are they like `pytorch_model-00004-of-00008.safetensors` or `weights_tp0.safetensors`?
Priya: Mine were named `cobalt13b-00004.safetensors` etc — compact 4-file pack. I thought we agreed 4 for early dev. Maybe we forgot to publish the 8-way repack.
Lina: Also noticed tokenizer.json had added_tokens with escaped bytes which caused tokenization length diffs in the eval harness. Example: "added_tokens": [{"content": "\\u2581\\u20ac"}] — our tokenizer loader treats those as separate unicode tokens. Use `tokenizer_util.py --normalize-added` to flatten.
Ben: Good call. For the serving tests I see mismatch in max_seq because tokenizer is producing different token counts than the model was trained on.
packaging-bot: PR #485 merged by @Priya. New manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-models/cobalt13b/v1/manifest-8shard.json (sha256: f2d9a1b...). Repack script: `scripts/repack_to_tp.sh --src s3://redwood-models/cobalt13b/v1/compact4/ --dst s3://redwood-models/cobalt13b/v1/8shard/ --tp 8`
Priya: Yep that was my compact upload. I'll kick off repack now to make 8 shards + run `tokenizer_util --normalize-added`. ETA ~25m.
Sam: Ping me when the repack finishes, I'll do a quick CR on the convert tool changes (small rename of tensor-parallel key mapping).
Mateo: For future conversions, add a pre-check: `jq -r .tensor_parallelism manifest.json` and assert matches actual shard count. Quick snippet: `cnt=$(ls *safetensors | wc -l); expected=$(jq .shard_count manifest.json); test "$cnt" -eq "$expected" || echo mismatch`
QA-bot: Smoke tests queued for cobalt13b v1/8shard. I'll post results here once done (approx 40-60m).
Ben: thanks — once repack/manifest are stable I'll re-run the packaging pipeline and then the serve-readiness smoke tests. Quick checksum command I run: `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/cobalt13b/v1/8shard/manifest-8shard.json - | jq .files[] | xargs -n1 -I{} sh -c 'aws s3 cp s3://redwood-models/cobalt13b/v1/8shard/{} - | sha256sum'`
Priya: FYI added a small note in the PR about tokenizer normalization and the `--merge-added` flag for the tokenizer builder.
Sam: I'll review the PR after lunch.
Ben: Great, keeping this thread as the coordination point. If anyone hits a hard blocker, @here and we can spin up a quick call. :thumbsup:
